provenance: Repository-authored synthetic C35 negative cases. Each mutation is applied only to a temporary copy or temporary install prefix; no real release, private key or accepted customer data is used.

cases.name: modified-manifest-byte
cases.mutation: change the signed revision byte without re-signing

cases.name: wrong-trusted-key
cases.mutation: verify with an independently generated but untrusted key

cases.name: expired-manifest
cases.mutation: sign a manifest whose validity window has elapsed

cases.name: missing-sbom
cases.mutation: delete the SBOM from a verified artifact copy

cases.name: untrusted-key-file
cases.mutation: supply a malformed trusted key file

cases.name: stale-revision-upgrade
cases.mutation: attempt a never-accepted revision at or below the durable high-water revision

cases.name: replayed-old-manifest
cases.mutation: replay the older accepted release after an upgrade

cases.name: newer-data-rollback
cases.mutation: point rollback at a store manifest with a newer schema

cases.name: malformed-data-manifest
cases.mutation: replace the store manifest with invalid JSON

cases.name: tampered-installed-release
cases.mutation: modify a file in the recorded previous release before rollback

cases.name: unsupported-host
cases.mutation: install a foreign-platform release without explicit staging permission

cases.name: network-import
cases.mutation: inspect direct imports of the release scripts for network capability
